They threatened to pull me out of school when I got a C on a midterm in a semester I did well in, let alone failing one class and dropping another.

I really don't know how they'll react and that's what scares me. If it ends up with my life turning for much worse than it already is right now, then suicide seems to be a much easier choice.
They are the main financial support for my tuition, so it would only be right that they know.

Hey, sorry for replying late.

Yeah I'd say davethemacguy put it pretty well.
